subject: send R code from aceEditor (shinyAce) in Shiny

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: send R code from aceEditor (shinyAce) in Shiny
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to use aceEditor from shinyAce package to show the ggplot2 code and send code to plot. However, I have not got any luck. Here is my code.

In the first part,  I want to be able to show R code in aceEditor based on my selectInput. Should i use updateAceEditor? not sure how?
After that, I want to send the code to plot. When I test the current code below, aceEditor can be updated if I commented out the plotting part. But the editor did not show up when I added the plotting part.

Any suggestion or comments is hight appreciated. Thanks.

library(shinyAce)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

ui <- fluidPage(
  fluidRow(column(4, selectInput('graphs','Graph',choices=c('mtcars1','mtcars2'))),
           column(4, uiOutput('ui'), actionButton("submit",'Submit R code')),
           column(4,plotOutput('gg'))))

server<-function(input, output){
  output$ui<-renderUI({
    switch(input$graphs,
           "mtcars1"=aceEditor("code", value="# Enter ggplot code   p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point(colour='grey50', size = 4) + geom_point(aes(colour = cyl)) + facet_wrap(~am, nrow = 2) p",
                              mode = "r", theme = "chrome", fontSize = 10),
            "mtcars2"=aceEditor("code", value="# Enter ggplot code p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point(colour='red', size = 6) + geom_point(aes(colour = am)) + facet_wrap(~am, nrow = 2) p",
                                mode = "r", theme = "chrome", fontSize = 10))
  })
  
  output$gg <- renderPlot({
    input$submit
    return(isolate(eval(parse(text=input$code))))
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)
